case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed women’s health platform unlocks $685K in recurring savings (3× ROI) in under six months
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Advantia Health’s rapid growth through acquisitions left the 40-location women’s health provider with fragmented vendors, inconsistent pricing, and no centralized procurement muscle. With private-equity owners pressing for EBITDA expansion, leadership needed to quickly take $0.7-1.4 M of cost out of both clinical and indirect spend without disrupting patient care or sensitive supplier relationships.
approach_summary: Mapped and cleansed $19 M of AP and P-card data across two legacy systems to pinpoint $13.7 M in addressable spend across 10 categories.
Renegotiated the high-stakes Athenahealth RCM contract—avoiding a $9 M termination fee while cutting fees from 3.39 % to 3.15 %, saving $259 K annually.
Ran competitive RFPs and distributor consolidations on medical supplies, shifting Heartland clinics to McKesson and driving 14 % ($157 K) savings.
Redesigned the sonography staffing model, transitioning from outsourced pay-per-scan to an in-house team that delivers $152 K (19 %) annual savings.
Implemented quick-win policy and manufacturer program changes in IUD purchasing and lab services, capturing an additional $119 K in low-lift savings within 45 days.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $684,936 in hard annual savings—already a 3.0× return on our $225 K fixed fee—with a further $146,492 in pipeline awards that will lift total savings to $831 K (3.7× ROI) once implemented. Beyond the financial impact, Advantia now has standardized purchasing policies, consolidated supplier footprints, and a clear roadmap for ongoing procurement governance that boosts EBITDA and enterprise value.
where_we_were_unique: Generated first measurable savings within 45 days by attacking policy-driven quick wins.
Healthcare-specific sourcing expertise enabled sensitive renegotiations (e.g., Athena RCM, LabCorp) without operational disruption.
Hands-on data cleansing bridged two disparate AP systems, giving Advantia its first unified view of spend.
Collaborative, clinician-friendly change management preserved care continuity while executing supplier transitions.
